claim_scope: Research-only exact-ownership evidence for the Python GlobalSettlementABI V1 boundary. Exact scalar, container, nested-record, outer-snapshot, effect-plan, and factory types reject behavior-bearing subclasses before their hooks can influence canonical state or effects. The packet does not close the generic canonicalizable registry or resource-budget gaps.
failure_modes: a string subclass executes encoding or prefix behavior before token or root rejection
a mapping or sequence subclass executes iteration while canonical bytes are derived
a nested lane-state or effect-row subclass supplies forged projection or key behavior
an outer global state, effect plan, occurrence, or journal subclass reaches reflective snapshot reconstruction
an accepted or rejected transition retains a subclassed effect plan
an inherited class factory dispatches through a subclass and constructs a behavior-bearing authority value

aaa.reason: Each regression arranges one exact valid authority value and one behavior-bearing subclass, invokes one admission, snapshot, transition, or factory boundary, and asserts the exact rejection plus non-execution of the hostile hook where observable.

reject_is_noop.reason: These tests exercise construction and projection admission before any state transition. Rejection returns no authority value and no effect plan; transition-level rejection purity remains covered by the shared GlobalSettlementABI suite.

points: equal behavior-bearing string subclass rejected before hook execution

boundary_dimensions.name: record_ownership

subclass dispatch rejects before content projection or construction

nonclaims: This packet establishes no production, settlement, release, migration, proof-receipt, or value-moving authority.
The generic _Canonicalizable to_canonical protocol remains open and needs a closed registry or private trusted boundary.
Canonical traversal still lacks one source-pinned cycle, depth, item, and byte budget.
Constructor and ownership errors do not yet share one typed canonical rejection-precedence algebra.
The evidence does not close every pool, perps, fill, delta, mounted publisher, durability, or no-bypass path.
Passing the hygiene gate proves only that the declared source and tests are current and executable.
